items.question: How do I use credits?
items.answer: Each image generation costs 1 credit, whether it's text-to-image or image-to-image mode. For batch generation, you're charged N credits for N images.

items.question: How long are credits valid?
items.answer: Credits are valid for 365 days from the date of purchase. Unused credits will expire after this period.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: Unfortunately, credits are non-refundable once purchased. Please make sure the package fits your needs before buying.

items.question: What is Priority Queue?
items.answer: Standard and Premium package users get priority generation queue, which is 2-5x faster than free users. The advantage is more noticeable during peak hours.

items.question: Can I purchase multiple times?
items.answer: Yes! You can purchase multiple packages, and credits will be accumulated in your account. Credits that expire first will be used first.

items.question: What payment methods are supported?
items.answer: Currently we support Stripe, PayPal, Alipay, and WeChat Pay. Available payment methods may vary by region.
